page_title: KINGAI Global Intelligence — Global Risk, Freedom & Wellbeing
hero_title: Understand global risk, freedom and wellbeing.
hero_text: Country-level evidence, transparent methodology and continuously published static data — without hiding uncertainty.
score_note: Scores are published only when source coverage and validation requirements are met. Missing values remain unavailable.
methodology_text: AI may classify, summarize and compare evidence, but measured country scores come from versioned rules and attributable datasets. The same core rules apply to every country.
principle_1_text: Unknown data stays unknown instead of being guessed.
principle_2_text: Every public metric can carry source, date and methodology metadata.
principle_3_text: China, the United States and every other country are evaluated under the same core framework.
footer_note: Public static intelligence snapshots. Verify critical decisions against primary sources.
